title: Cytokines and Acute Phase Reactants as Markers of Pulmonary Tuberculosis Treatment
brief_summary: Tuberculosis is a highly prevalent chronic infectious disease caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis. Cytokines are important biological mediators that regulate immune and inflammatory responses against the bacilli, witch include the acute phase response. Besides this, it becomes essential to determine markers of healing lesions, once this is currently carried out based on the clinical, radiological, and negative bacterioscopy.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* diagnosis of Mycobacterium tuberculosis infection

Exclusion Criteria:

* all other granulomatous or neoplastic diseases
